name: california-housing
title: California Housing — district-level census aggregates
description: 16,640 California census-block-group districts with median income, housing age, room and occupancy averages, population, position and median house value. This is the source's train split; the full dataset has 20,640 districts. Demo data: referenced by pinned URL and revision and built locally. Meridian does not host or publish this dataset.

median_income.description: Median household income for the district, in tens of thousands of 1990 US dollars.

house_age.description: Median age of the district's houses, in years.

avg_rooms.description: Mean rooms per household. A district average, so values above ten are small households in large houses rather than errors.

avg_bedrooms.description: Mean bedrooms per household, on the same district-average basis.

population.description: Number of people resident in the district.

latitude.description: District centroid latitude. With longitude, this is a map that needs no embedding behind it.

median_house_value.description: Median house value for the district, in hundreds of thousands of 1990 US dollars. Capped at 5.00001 in the source, which is a ceiling rather than a measurement.
